name: Cobhthach

province that Cobhthach wanted for himself

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cobhthach, also called Covac, was a cruel Irish king. He forced his young brother, Labhraigh Lore, to eat mice, and the child was so frightened that he stopped speaking. Some accounts call Cobhthach the uncle of Labhraigh. In his greed for the throne of the province of Leinster, Cobhthach put the young man to death and took the province for himself.

okr.objective: Cobhthach was a cruel king who silenced and killed his brother for Leinster.
